result.summary: Found 3 issues: two major layout problems with cut-off content in restaurant cards and category filters, and one minor styling issue with incomplete information display.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section (Trattoria Piccol) is horizontally cut off, with the restaurant name truncated and partial content visible
issues.suggestion: Ensure the carousel or grid properly displays all cards or implement a clear scrolling indicator to show users more content is available horizontally

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card (appears to be a pizza place with -20% discount) is vertically cut off, showing incomplete information and no clear way to view full details
issues.suggestion: Add proper padding/spacing at the bottom of the scrollable content area or ensure cards are fully visible within the viewport before content cutoff

issues.description: The category filter row shows a partially visible button on the far right edge, indicating horizontal overflow without clear scroll affordance
issues.suggestion: Either display all category buttons with proper spacing or add a clear scroll indicator/arrow to show users they can scroll horizontally to see more categories
